description: This file is an entry point script in a SuiteCRM module that handles redirecting to external OAuth providers for authentication. It checks for a valid entry point, loads necessary services, verifies provider support, manages session data, and initiates OAuth authorization redirect.

classes.name: OAuthAuthorizationService
classes.description: A service class responsible for handling OAuth authorization logic, including provider validation, session management, and redirect initiation.

methods.name: hasProvider
methods.description: Checks whether the specified OAuth provider is supported and properly configured.

methods.name: cleanSession
methods.description: Clears session data related to OAuth process.

methods.name: authorizationRedirect
methods.description: Initiates the OAuth authorization process by redirecting the user agent to the provider's authorization endpoint.
